# ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io Daily Update (Feb 2, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
Today's development focused on adding a new `index.html` file and integrating the RNBW token data, alongside ongoing discussions on critical issues related to `op-supernode` and `Flashblocks` support.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

### Core Website Updates
A new `index.html` file was added to the repository, indicating foundational updates or additions to the website's structure. ([#1265](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/pull/1265))

### RNBW Token Integration
The RNBW token was integrated, including its `data.json`, `logo.svg`, and `icon.svg` files, suggesting an expansion of supported tokens or assets within the Optimism ecosystem. ([#1264](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/pull/1264))

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
No new pull requests were opened today.

## CLOSED ISSUES
No issues were closed today.

## NEW ISSUES
No new issues were reported today.

## ACTIVE ISSUES

### `op-supernode`: Safe Label Adjusting ([#18976](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/18976))
Discussion continues on how to manage the "Safe" label across different layers (EL, CL, Superchain) to avoid deadlocks and ensure consistent state. The latest update suggests having the CL maintain a full set of pointers (U, S, C, F) and remain the sole controller of the engine, with the `op-supernode` controlling the engine via the virtual node/CL. This approach aims to address the challenge of multiple stateful controllers and potential desynchronization. The idea of an "authority" object within the virtual node is also being considered to delegate some decision-making, allowing the virtual node to remain largely unaware of interop specifics.

### Flashblocks support within Geth ([#756](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/756))
The conversation highlights the internal addition of Flashblocks support in `op-geth` for processing events from Websockets and tracing them. A contributor shared their `op-geth` version which includes Firehose Live Tracer and Flashblock(s) support, suggesting a potential path for merging these features into the main `op-geth` branch. The benefit of this integration is noted as a way to reduce disk space consumption compared to running archive versions of Reth.

### Feedback: `BlockNotFoundError` in Step 5 (Prove the withdrawal on L1) ([#1956](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/1956))
The issue discusses a `BlockNotFoundError` encountered during the withdrawal proving step in the ETH bridge tutorial. The latest comment points out that while Optimism SDK packages include `isValidOutputRoot` validation, Viem's withdrawal guide and actions do not appear to perform equivalent output root validation. This lack of validation in Viem could lead to issues where an invalid output is used, causing the `BlockNotFoundError`.
